trust_decision.summary: Bundled advisory with two decisions: (1) xDS RBAC policy compilation decides which permission/principal rule types become matchers; unsupported/unknown types are silently dropped, so AND/NOT trees widen or a NOT over an empty list indexes mList[0] and panics (CWE-863/248), in internal/xds/rbac/matchers.go; (2) the HTTP/2 control buffer decides which queued control items count toward the read-throttle limit; most peer-triggered items were not counted, allowing unbounded queue growth (CWE-770), in internal/transport/controlbuf.go.

landing_point.why: The summary names 'xDS RBAC'; matchersFromPermissions/matchersFromPrincipals is the policy-to-matcher compiler and holds the visibly no-op cases for Metadata, RequestedServerName and SourceIp.

fix_sites.entry_point: xDS server LDS HttpConnectionManager RBAC filter (ParseFilterConfig) and RDS RBACPerRoute override (ParseFilterConfigOverride), via rbac.NewChainEngine
fix_sites.module_kind: policy compiler (core RBAC engine, internal package)
